description: This file implements a React component called OAuthQuickConnectWidget meant for facilitating OAuth connections to Git providers (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket). It manages the connection state, initiates OAuth login flows, and displays connection status indicators within a UI component.

methods.name: Dot
methods.description: A React sub-component that displays a colored dot indicating connection status.

methods.name: getReturnTo
methods.description: Constructs the callback URL for OAuth provider redirection.

methods.name: OAuthQuickConnectWidget
methods.description: Main React component for displaying OAuth connection options and managing connection state.
